prompts.base: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: layered website music player illustration. Draw ONLY a charming vintage wooden record player BASE, WITHOUT a record and WITHOUT a tonearm. Hand sketched loose dark graphite pencil outlines, lively imperfect cartoon contours, pencil crosshatching, soft ochre tan watercolor washes, cream highlights, paper texture inside painted surfaces, same artisanal cozy cookbook style. View almost directly overhead, with only a little front-edge depth: the top surface is a horizontal rectangular rounded wooden box occupying central 90% of a landscape 6:5 canvas. The circular empty light tan platter recess is LEFT of center at approximately 42% canvas width and 44% canvas height, circular radius approximately 29% canvas width. The empty platter should appear gently elliptical vertically, not an extreme perspective. A small gold circular tonearm pivot on upper right, two little knobs lower right, tiny wood front panel and feet below. No lid, no text, no record/vinyl disc, no tonearm, no music notes, no humans. Separate vinyl record and tonearm will be layered over this asset by code. Everything outside the illustrated wooden player is genuinely transparent; no white rectangle and no cast shadow background. Leave a slim transparent margin around the entire object.
prompts.record: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: independently spinning vinyl record layer for an animated illustrated website player. One circular black charcoal VINYL RECORD, viewed PERFECTLY straight overhead, entire disc visible and centered with a slim transparent margin. Genuine transparent background outside the circle. Cozy cartoon-ish hand drawn graphite-pencil and watercolor cookbook style: scratchy uneven charcoal outer contours, delicate concentric groove pencil lines, fine graphite crosshatching, subtle uneven gray reflected highlights and loose hand sketched marks. Terracotta red central paper label with a small sage green four-leaf clover doodle, a cream inner ring and tiny center spindle hole. No text, no writing, no watermark. NOT glossy 3D, NOT a photograph, NOT flat clean vector. Keep the geometry nearly circular so this separate image can rotate smoothly; the webpage will turn it into an oval through perspective. Just ONE record, no player, no extra objects.
